title: Widget data
description: The data file that a Home widget reads (its source in LocalAI/home.json).

updatedAt.description: When the data was written, as an RFC 3339 time such as 2026-10-29T08:00:00Z.

source.description: Who wrote the data: a trigger run, a page, the assistant in a chat, or the person.

trigger.description: The id of the trigger whose run wrote it.

page.description: The name of the page that wrote it (pages/<name>/).

note.description: One line on where the data comes from, such as Mail from the last 24 hours.

meta.description: A short note on the right, such as a day.

value.description: The number of a metric widget.

note.description: One line under the value of a metric widget.

series.description: Points of the small line under a metric.
